caption: A power strip with four lamps plugged into it is switched on, and all four lamps come on at once.

sa.check: A power strip with four lamps plugged into it.
The strip's switch is turned on.
The lamps come on at the same moment, not one after another.
The lamps are dark before the switch.

pc.expect: All four lamps come on at the moment the strip's switch is pressed, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is pressed and one or more lamps stay dark; or a lamp is lit before the switch is touched; or the lamps light one after another; or the lamps come on with the switch untouched.

pc.expect: The four lamps seen dark are the four lamps seen lit: the same lamps in the same places, none appearing or vanishing.
pc.fail: A fifth lamp appears lit; or a lamp vanishes at the switch; or a lamp changes place; or the strip gains or loses sockets.

pc.expect: Once on, all four lamps stay lit while the switch stays on.
pc.fail: A lamp goes out again with the switch untouched; or lamps flicker; or the switch flips back by itself; or a lamp dims to dark while the others glow.

pc.expect: The lamps' light reaches their surroundings: shades glow and the surfaces beneath brighten, with shadows pointing away from each lamp.
pc.fail: The bulbs glow while the shades and surfaces stay as dark as before; or the surroundings brighten while the lamps stay dark; or the light comes from elsewhere.

pc.expect: One strip with four plugs in it; the strip and lamps keep their shape; cords stay attached; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A plug passes into the strip's body beside a socket; or a cord splits or detaches; or a lamp changes shape; or the hand passes through the strip.

pc.expect: The lamps' shade colours, the strip's colour and the floor stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: A shade changes colour rather than brightness; or the strip changes colour; or the cords change colour.
